changes: Add one-tap Pencil, Chalk, Watercolour and Oil pigments to draggable tool rail, plus keys 1–4
Add persistent top-center status strip for mode, effect, material, brush tip, colour, size and canvas zoom
Simplify palette to colour-first grid with native picker as first tile; condense six presets and generation/import controls
Add category-filterable brush-tip library with enlarged visual previews and translucent labels
Import PNG and other images as black/alpha brush tips or capture current painted canvas as a tip
Store compact custom-tip alpha masks in named presets and editable project JSON
Improve layer interactivity with incremental add/clone/remove/reorder/opacity operations and canvas-drawn thumbnails
Page history entries in bounded batches to preserve responsiveness with large stroke histories without discarding actions
Retain full replay only for undo/redo and restoring saved projects
Fix Command+/ and Ctrl+/ keyboard help on desktop, including shifted question-mark combination
Replace text-symbol UI controls with supplied SVG artwork across the toolbar, panels, layers and shape tools
Keep SVG icons compatible with selected UI font, all four themes and custom panel colours
Reuse existing server Certbot accounts automatically when issuing paint-lab.xyz TLS certificate
Improve watcher output with high-contrast ANSI colour and start/success/failure banners
Add regression tests for certificate account selection
Split compact layer UI and draggable tools from existing painting editor
Add quick pencil/chalk/watercolour/oil pigment switch
Add Flask, SQLite account-scoped cloud canvases and WebSocket notifications
Add encrypted per-user model API-key vault and read-only connectivity probes
Add versioned checksum-verified deployment watcher, nginx and systemd installer
